hook: A Raspberry Pi camera with 26 TOPS of AI

beats.say: Hellbender's Tendryl Camera packs a Raspberry Pi CM5 and a Hailo-8 AI accelerator into a compact fanless box.
It adds a 12 megapixel camera module, a speaker and microphone, an IMU, and temperature, humidity and pressure sensors.
With Gigabit Ethernet and PoE plus, it measures 85 by 82 by 58 millimeters, weighs 415 grams, and targets computer vision prototyping.
